title: L&T Secures AI Data Centre Order Worth Up to ₹15,000 Crore

blocks.content: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) announced on 13 August 2026 that it won a mega order valued between ₹10,000 crore and ₹15,000 crore for an artificial intelligence infrastructure facility in India. The project is described as India’s largest single-cluster AI infrastructure facility and will be executed through L&T’s AI infrastructure subsidiary, LTN Compute, and its digital infrastructure arm, Vyoma.AI.

items: Larsen & Toubro is an Indian multinational engineering, procurement, and construction company.
GPU stands for Graphics Processing Unit, and it is widely used in artificial intelligence and scientific computing.
MW means megawatt, while MVA means megavolt-ampere in power system terminology.
Chennai is one of India’s major data centre hubs in the southern region.
